# Biscuit the Camping Bulldog — Xtreme Heaters Shop

Page: https://xtremeheaters.biscuitthecampingbulldog.com/

A shop for Xtreme Heaters freeze protection for RVs and campers: underbelly and compartment heaters (400W to 1000W), money-saving 2-packs, a space heater for inside the camper, and mounting brackets, a shore power adapter and freeze spray. Every order button links to the matching product on xtremeheaters.com through the shop's partner link.

Who runs it: Biscuit the Camping Bulldog (Denise & Jeffrey Myers, full-time RVers), an Xtreme Heaters affiliate partner. Orders may earn a commission at no extra cost to the buyer.

Honest note from the page: they found Xtreme Heaters at the Hershey RV Show and don't run one in their rig yet.
